note: Wallet-to-bank commission at settlement. Disposable per-process database; fixture rates only, no production policy.

approvedNonzeroRule.rule: PERCENTAGE 100bps of PRINCIPAL (1.00%), AGENT recipient, canonical WALLET_TO_BANK

explicitZero.distinction: a configured rule that computed to zero — not an absent rule

noRuleConfigured.distinction: evaluated and found nothing — never recorded as a zero

releasedTransfer.rule: PERCENTAGE 100bps of PRINCIPAL — deliberately configured so absence is meaningful
releasedTransfer.conclusion: a transfer that never completed cannot pay anyone

wrongAgentAttribution.rule: targeted at a DIFFERENT explicit agentId
wrongAgentAttribution.conclusion: the recipient must be eligible, not merely present
